We had just shot (a commercial) before that. I thought, âLet me send a message to Smritiâ and I mentioned, âPlease wish everyone who is part of the team," Dhoni said.India created history on November 2, 2025, defeating South Africa by 52 runs in Navi Mumbai to win their first-ever Women's ODI World Cup.
